3. Chuan dau ra
Chuan dau ra cua chuong trinh dao tao dugc xay dung nham cu the hoa muc tieu
dao tao, dong thoi bao dam su phu hop voi Khung trinh do quoc gia Viet Nam doi voi
trinh do dai hoc, theo dinh huong hinh thanh ? nguoi hoc he thong nang luc toan dien
gom kien thurc, ky nang va muc do ty chu -- trach nhiem.
3.1. Chuan dau ra ve kién thurc
PLO1. Van dung kién thurc nen tang ve khoa hoc xa hoi, van hoa, nghe thuat,
cong nghe va kinh doanh trong hoat dong thiet ke sang tao
PLO2. Van dung va danh gia cac nguyen ly my thuat, tao hinh, quy trinh va
phuong phap thiét ke trong phat trien san pham thoi trang.
PLO3. Phan tich xu hurong, ban sac thiet ke va boi canh van hoa - xa hoi trong
phat trien san pham va chien luoc thiet ke thoi trang.
PLO4. Van dung kien thuc ly thuyét va thuc tien ve quy trinh thiet ke va phat
trien san pham dap irng yeu cau tham my, cong nghe va thi truong trong linh vrc thoi
trang.
3.2. Chuan dau ra ve ky nang
PLO5. Phat trien y tuong thiet ke va xay dung bo suu tap thoi trang tu nghien
curu den san pham hoan chinh.
PLO6. Thuc hien cac ky thuat thiet ke va che tac san pham thoi trang bao gom
ve thiet ke, thiet ke rap, draping, may lap rap va hoan thien san pham mau.
PLO7. Ung dung hieu qua cac cong nghe thiet ké thoi trang s6 (2D-3D, rap ky
thuat so, mo phong trang phuc) va cac cong cu sang tao ky thuat so trong nghien curu,

3.4. Vi tri viec lam ma sinh vien co the dam nhiem sau khi tot nghiep
Sinh vien tot nghiep tir chuong trinh Cur nhan Thoi trang va Sang tao c6 the lam
viec trong cac co quan, doanh nghiep thuoc khoi nha nuoc, khoi tu nhan va cac to churc
xa hoi - nghe nghiep hoat dong trong linh vrc thiét ke thoi trang, phat trien san pham,
cong nghiep sang tao, truyen thong - thuong hieu va van h6a nghe thuat.
Cac vi tri viec lam ma sinh vien co the dam nhiem duoc phan thanh cac nhom sau:
(1) Vi tri khoi diem
- Nhan vien thiet ke thoi trang (Fashion Designer): Lam viec tai bo phan thiet ké
cua doanh nghiep hoac to chuc trong linh vurc thoi trang va cong nghiep sang tao. Cong
viec c6 the bao gom thiét ké y tuong va ve mau, phat trien mau rap (2D-3D), thiét ké
chat lieu va be mat vai, thiét ke do hoa thoi trang, thiet ke phu kien va tham gia qua trinh
phat trien san pham thoi trang.
- Nhan vien Stylist: Lam viec tai bo phan thiet ke, marketing hoac hoat dong doc
lap. Cong viec chu yéu la tu van hinh anh, tao kieu va phoi hop trang phuc - phu kien
nham xay dung hinh anh cho thuong hieu hoac khach hang ca nhan. Stylist co the tham
gia cac hoat dong trong linh vurc thoi trang, lam dep, truyen hinh, dien anh, quang cao,
su kien va truyen thong.

(2) Vi tri phat trien nghe nghiep
- Quan ly thiet ke: Tham gia dieu phoi va quan ly cac hoat dong thiet ke trong
doanh nghiep hoac dy an. Cong viec bao gom lap ke hoach trien khai thiet ke, phan cong
nhiem vu cho nhom thiet ke, kiem soat chat luong san pham, phoi hop v6i cac don vi tu
van thiét ké trong va ngoai nuoc, tham gia quan ly tién do va trien khai cac dy an phat
trien san pham thoi trang.
- Quan ly thuong hieu thoi trang: Tham gia xay dung, phat trien va quan ly hinh
anh thurong hieu thoi trang trong doanh nghiep hoac to churc. Cong viec bao gom xay
dung chien lurgc thuong hieu, dinh huong hinh anh va phong cach truyen thong, phoi
hop voi cac bo phan thiét ke, marketing va truyen thong de trien khai cac chien dich
quang ba san pham; quan ly noi dung truyen thong, to churc sy kien thoi trang, phat trien
he thong nhan dien thuong hieu va mo rong thi truong cho san pham thoi trang.
- Truong nhom thiet ke/sang tao: Dieu phoi va dinh huong cac hoat dong sang
tao trong nhom thiet ke hoac truyen thong. Cong viec bao gom phat trien y tuong thiet
ke, dinh huong phong cach hinh anh cho san pham hoac chien dich truyen thong, phoi
hop voi cac bo phan thiét ke, marketing va san xuat de trien khai cac dy an sang tao
trong linh vyc thoi trang va cong nghiep sang tao.
(3) Vi tri lanh dao sang tao trong lo trinh nghe nghiep

nguoi hoc c6 the phat trien lén cac vi tri quan ly thiét ke/sang tao:
- Giam doc thiét ke: To churc quan ly, dieu hanh va kiem soat cac hoat dong thiet
ke cua doanh nghiep hoac don vi thiét ke; xay dung chién luoc phat trien san pham,
quan ly quy trinh thiét ke va trien khai du an; dieu phoi doi ngu thiet ke va cac doi tac
lien quan nham bao dam chat lurong va hieu qua cua cac dy an thiet ke.
- Giam doc sang tao: Chiu trach nhiem xay dung dinh huong sang tao va hinh
anh thuong hieu cua doanh nghiep; phat trien cac y tuong thiet ke va chien luoc truyen
thong; lanh dao doi ngu sang tao trong viec trien khai cac chien dich hinh anh, san pham
va thong diep thuong hieu.
